detail:
S162 contract comparison 2026-11-04 (read only; files: 99ribu src/modules/shipping/{mengantar,rates,destinations}.ts, src/modules/payments/{autolaris,autolaris-live}.ts, src/config/{local,runtime}.ts @d362a70; adsbookcms scripts/dev-providers.ts @a913fcb (main); mengantar-documentation/docs 01,08; autolaris-h2h guides/payment-gateway.md). Side = who changes.
M1 path confirmed: mengantar.ts:49 GET {base}/api/public/{key}/order/estimate; docs 01:15; stand-in dp:204 any key. Side: none.
M2 courier keys CORRECTED: 99ribu COURIERS mengantar.ts:18 = JNE,SiCepat,SAP,SAPLite,iDexpress,JT,lion,anteraja,spx,pos. Stand-in dp:21-33 serves JNE,SiCepat,SAP,lion,pos,spx (VISIBLE, 6) plus J&T,Anteraja,IDexpress,Paxel (HIDDEN by 99ribu). Side: stand-in (S171); never add fake keys to COURIERS.
M3 courier param confirmed: 99ribu sends courier=all (:47); docs 01:243 single courier case-sensitive, unknown -> 400 Invalid courier; stand-in ignores courier. Side: stand-in (S171); 99ribu unaffected (always all).
M4 flags confirmed: hides unsupported/unsupportedOriginSpx (:29); COD only unsupported_cod===false && coverage_cod!==false (:37); docs add unsupportedPickup (meaning [verifikasi]); stand-in unsupported always false, unsupported_cod=!cod (Paxel only true, and Paxel is hidden) -> in stand-in mode every visible courier offers COD. Side: stand-in (S171) for switchable flags; tests use in-test fake.
M5 area id confirmed: 99ribu 24-hex (destinations.ts:161); stand-in /address/search dev-area-N, SUBDISTRICT_NAME=district, ZIP "" (dp:47-54); stand-in estimate takes any id (areaNumber = trailing digits). Side: 99ribu uses its own app.shipping_area catalogue (DEC-028 D2).
M6 price confirmed: 99ribu bills price (:30); stand-in price is a fake formula (base+perKg+distance). Side: accept; never assert amounts as tariffs.
M7 ETD CORRECTED: stand-in gives "{2+d}-{3+d}" (varies with distance, dp:97), parsed by :33 regex. Side: none.
M8 errors confirmed: 99ribu -> HTTP n / malformed / unreachable (:50-52) -> rates.ts maps to 503 SHIPPING_RATE_UNAVAILABLE; docs X000-X003, 400, 403 (POS COD on POST /order), 409/429 (not estimate). Stand-in none. Side: stand-in (S171) levers; S165 uses in-test fake.
M9 timeout confirmed: fetch 5000 ms (:16,:49); estimateRates cap min(2000,remaining) (rates.ts:45); effective 2000 ms. Docs: no timeout/rate limit published. Side: none (document).
M10 NEW COD_AMOUNT: 99ribu never sends COD_AMOUNT (query :47 = origin_id,destination_id,courier,weight) and ignores codFee; stand-in codFee only when COD_AMOUNT sent. COD fee is not taken from the provider. Side: none.
A1 create CONFIRMED BLOCKING: 99ribu autolaris-live.ts:64 POST /api/h2h/create_payment; docs guide:8-9,25 create_payment vs submit, never both; stand-in serves submit only (dp:154) -> create_payment answers 404 "not found" -> liveAutolaris throws "HTTP 404" -> dispatch leaves responded_at null (unknown) and replays. Side: stand-in (S171, not approved) -> S166 uses an in-test fake.
A2 fee CONFIRMED, owner/S97 question: 99ribu refuses provider amount!=requested or total!=requested (autolaris.ts:156, store-borne fee DEC-008(3)); docs sample amount 11000 admin 3000 total 14000 and QRIS 10000->70->10070 (guide:182-205) i.e. fee ON TOP; stand-in submit total=grand_total. With the docs' behaviour every real create would be refused as AUTOLARIS_TOTAL_MISMATCH unless the account is configured merchant-borne. Side: owner/S97; stand-in fee_mode (S171) only makes both testable.
A3 advice CONFIRMED: 99ribu settles only rc 00 + data.status PAID + integer amount (autolaris.ts:25,32); docs: only 02 PENDING observed, final statuses unpublished (guide:249-256); stand-in rc 00 ket PAID data {awb:""} -> classifies UNKNOWN in 99ribu (never settles). Side: stand-in settle lever flagged invented (S171); S97 closes.
A4 reff_id CONFIRMED: 99ribu 99R+attempt id without dashes (autolaris.ts:105), same value replayed; docs: unique, persist first, keep reff_id on timeout, duplicate rule unpublished (guide:159,270-280); stand-in neither echoes nor dedupes. Side: stand-in (S171).
A5 channels CONFIRMED: 99ribu closed list VABNI,VAPERMATA,VABCA,VAMANDIRI,VABRI,QRIS (autolaris.ts:21) intersected with list_payment; stand-in returns those six channel_code only (no name/admin/tipe_admin) -> name falls back to code. Side: none.
A6 callback CONFIRMED: raw body stored, no state change (autolaris.ts:208); docs contract unpublished (guide:167); stand-in sends none. Side: none.
A7 expiry CONFIRMED: 99ribu sends expired YYYYMMDDHHMMSS in WIB (autolaris.ts:110-113); docs timezone unpublished (guide:165); stand-in submit fixed now+24h. Side: stand-in expire lever (S171).
A8 transport CONFIRMED: live reader https only (autolaris-live.ts:27), Bearer, redirect:error, 10 s; docs Bearer + IP whitelist max 5 (guide:45), 401/403 -> check key, no fast retry (guide:267); stand-in any bearer, http. Side: 99ribu adds a separate loopback reader (S166) without weakening the https reader.
A9 NEW callback_url scheme: docs require HTTPS (guide:167); 99ribu sends readLocalConfig origin http://127.0.0.1:3099/... (autolaris.ts:152), local only. Side: accept locally; S97 production needs https.
A10 NEW rc 01/07: docs 01 invalid request, 07 channel inactive (guide:268-269) -> parseCreatePayment treats any rc!=00 as rejected -> operation failed (no retry). Side: none; stand-in levers (S171) would exercise it.
Model: AdsBookCMS kecamatan-level areas vs 99ribu kelurahan+postcode -> D2 confirmed (catalogue, not stand-in search). AdsBookCMS retries a failed create with a NEW reff_id; 99ribu keeps the same reff_id (matches guide:276-280) -> do not copy.
